payload.reason: The evidence describes the use of a Meta-LSTM as a meta learning algorithm for multi-task learning, which captures shared knowledge across tasks and predicts parameters for task-specific networks.

claims.text: The algorithm used is a Meta-LSTM, which serves as a meta network to capture shared knowledge across tasks.
The Meta-LSTM can learn at the meta-level, predicting parameters for task-specific networks.
The Meta-LSTM facilitates knowledge transfer to new tasks, improving performance on unseen tasks.
